name: Apex Algs 2026
information:
**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApexAlgs2026#63000-competitor-information) prior to registering.**
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

**Due to space limitations, each competitor is only allowed to bring TWO guests with them to the competition. Yes, parents and siblings count as guests.**

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing Inc](https://southeastcubing.org/about)
